    "title": "Track Person Behaviors with an Abstract Class and Overridden move Method",
    "description": "An object in OOP has attributes and behaviors. Complete the program so that different kinds of Person objects share common behaviors but use different moving rules.\n\nRequirements:\n- Create an abstract class Person with attributes name, energy, and successfulMoves.\n- Implement these methods in Person:\n  - eat(): increase energy by 5.\n  - drink(): increase energy by 2.\n  - sleep(): increase energy by 10.\n  - getEnergy(): return current energy.\n  - getSuccessfulMoves(): return the number of successful move actions.\n- Person must also declare an abstract method move(int distance).\n- Create two subclasses:\n  - Walker: a move is successful only if energy is at least distance.
